title: Supabase Realtime postgres_changes subscription says SUBSCRIBED but never receives any events
symptoms: Channel status SUBSCRIBED, then silence when rows change
INSERT events arrive for one table but not for a newly created one
payload.old is empty or only holds the primary key on UPDATE and DELETE
cause: Realtime only watches tables added to the supabase_realtime publication, and it applies RLS as the subscribing user, so a blocked row is dropped silently. Old values on UPDATE and DELETE need replica identity full, and with RLS on only the primary key comes through.
fix: Add the table to the publication, confirm the subscriber can select the changed row, and set replica identity full if you need old values on tables without RLS.
affected: Supabase Realtime postgres_changes on all plans
